div.div:
Why one AZ for endpoints
Each interface endpoint costs about $7.30 per month per AZ (AWS list price, not measured). Four endpoints in one AZ instead of two saves about $29 per month. The trade-off is that the in-VPC Lambdas stop if AZ a fails.
